ownerStatement: The owner reviewed E-Verb 0.1.2-experimental (pull request #697) on 19 October 2026 and chose to merge it without current-build hardware testing, on emulator-only evidence.
reason: Drafted by the module author's agent so that the owner's merge publishes without a follow-up; merging is the owner's approval of this exact native source with only current-build hardware waived. 0.1.2 stops the DSP ring at 15,870 words so it no longer writes or reads Sidechain Compressor's key window on T3 and T7, and caps the pre-delay at 227 ms from PRE 124; every tested setting below PRE 124 renders bit-identically to 0.1.1. The frame loop's instructions are unchanged, the per-call bound recomputes to the same 47,680 cycles/core/block (evidence/release-bounds.md), the program grows by 14 words, and the matched benchmark reproduces 0.1.1's figures. Verified on the DSP and ColdFire emulators only: hardware status stays historical (the owner's MKII report covers 0.1.0), and physical hardware, MKI and chip timing remain unverified for 0.1.2.
